title: The Luxury Splurge Board
seo_title: Luxury Charcuterie Board: Shopping List & Plan for 8–12
description: The no-compromise charcuterie board for 8–12: Parmigiano-Reggiano, Époisses, Humboldt Fog, Stilton, jamón ibérico, truffle honey and honeycomb.
hook: The board for the night that deserves it. Every ingredient is the best of its kind, and the plan makes sure each one gets tasted properly.
why: Five cheeses, five styles: a hard grana, a washed rind, an ash-lined goat, a blue and an aged Gouda. Each one shows a different thing aging can do, so the board works as a tasting from mild to strong.

The accompaniments are matched, not scattered. Truffle honey goes on the Parmigiano, quince paste beside the aged Gouda, honeycomb next to the Stilton. Jamón ibérico needs nothing at all: serve it at room temperature so its fat turns glossy.

timeline.what: Take every cheese out. Room temperature is not optional here.
Set out the marble, slate or wooden board.
Place the cheeses, then lay the jamón on its own.
Add the accompaniments; truffle honey goes on last.
A drop of aged balsamic on the Parmigiano; guests arrive.

faq.q: How many people does this board serve?
faq.a: 8 to 12 people as an appetizer, on a 24–30 inch marble or slate board.
Jamón ibérico and a properly aged Parmigiano-Reggiano. If you cut one thing for budget, cut the duck prosciutto.

faq.q: Why take the cheese out an hour ahead?
faq.a: Cold mutes aroma and makes soft cheeses firm. Époisses and Humboldt Fog need the full hour to become spoonable.
